# NTSC composite

Sends the image through a simulated composite video signal and back: soft color, crawling dots along edges and rainbow artifacts in fine detail, like a game console on an old TV.

<EffectDemo effect="ntsc" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { ntsc } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/ntsc';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(ntsc({ preset: 'console' }));
// Animated effects hold still until play() (or { autoplay: true }).
composer.play();
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.artifacts = 1`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter    | Type    | Default | Range      | Description                                                     |
| ------------ | ------- | ------- | ---------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `artifacts`  | number  | `1`     | 0 – 1      | Mix between the clean image and the composite decode.           |
| `sharpness`  | number  | `0.4`   | 0 – 1      | Luma sharpness; sharper keeps more detail and more dot crawl.   |
| `resolution` | number  | `640`   | 160 – 1280 | Signal samples per line.                                        |
| `dotCrawl`   | boolean | `true`  |            | Alternate the subcarrier phase every frame, so artifacts crawl. |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset    | Settings                            |
| --------- | ----------------------------------- |
| `console` | `resolution: 320`, `sharpness: 0.6` |
| `soft`    | `sharpness: 0`, `resolution: 480`   |
| `subtle`  | `artifacts: 0.5`                    |
| `still`   | `dotCrawl: false`                   |

Apply one with `ntsc({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Retro & display · tracked as story X7.10 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Freezes: when motion is off (reduced motion, high contrast or `composer.motion = false`) the effect holds its current frame.
- **Cost:** 108.2 ms added to a 960×540 frame on CI container (SwiftShader software renderer) (2026-10-11). A software renderer: use it to compare effects, not to predict GPU times.
- **Size:** 7.3 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/ntsc`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Credits

Original implementation (MIT). References: NTSC composite encoding of YIQ on a 4×-sampled color subcarrier, with box-filtered luma and synchronous chroma demodulation.
